children.name: Daria is a Makeup Artist and Hair Stylist experienced in fashion, beauty, commercial, editorial and music productions. My background includes commercial and creative productions, fashion shows, backstage work, brand campaigns, music videos and private celebrity clients. I create complete beauty looks, combining makeup and hairstyling, from clean and natural commercial beauty to more complex fashion and editorial concepts. Previously based and professionally active in Moscow, Russia. Currently based in Shenzhen, China, and available for projects throughout China and worldwide, including international travel and on-location productions.
